kurz: Gelatine is purified [[kollagen-gelatine|collagen]]. It dissolves in warmth and makes liquids set as they cool.
bild_im_kopf: Like a net in powder form.
was_passiert: Gelatine comes from connective tissue. Soaked and dissolved, it forms a network as it cools that melts again at body temperature.
faustregeln: Agar-agar is a plant-based alternative, but it has to boil and sets firmer.
